message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap && sed -n '830,900p' gencode.c && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
p.write_text('[{"step":1,"file":"testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":10,"var":"Data/Size","code":"pcap_open_dead(Data[Size-1], 0xFFFF)","note":"The attacker-controlled input supplies the link-layer type and the filter string bytes."},{"step":2,"file":"testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":19,"var":"filter","code":"filter = malloc(Size); memcpy(filter, Data, Size); filter[Size-1] = 0;","note":"The entire input is copied into a NUL-terminated C string passed to the compiler."},{"step":3,"file":"gencode.c","function":"pcap_compile","line":804,"var":"cstate.ic","code":"if (bpf_optimize(&cstate.ic, p->errbuf) == -1)","note":"After parsing the filter into a BPF instruction graph, the compiler invokes the optimizer on that graph."},{"step":4,"file":"optimize.c","function":"bpf_optimize","line":1905,"var":"opt_state","code":"opt_cleanup(&opt_state);","note":"On the first optimization pass, failure during optimization triggers cleanup of allocated optimizer state."},{"step":5,"file":"optimize.c","function":"bpf_optimize","line":1925,"var":"opt_state","code":"opt_cleanup(&opt_state);","note":"The normal exit path also frees the same optimizer state, so a failure after cleanup can lead to a second free of the same pointers."},{"step":6,"file":"optimize.c","function":"opt_cleanup","line":2032,"var":"opt_state->vnode_base","code":"free((void *)opt_state->vnode_base); free((void *)opt_state->vmap); free((void *)opt_state->edges); free((void *)opt_state->space); free((void *)opt_state->levels); free((void *)opt_state->blocks);","note":"The sink is the repeated deallocation of the same heap-backed optimizer arrays, matching the reported heap-double-free crash state."}]')
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '--- submitting ---' && true` executed with exit code 0.
